title: [FE-1021] compiler: check assignments against variable schemas
body:
Assignments now check whether a known value fits the destination variable's schema. For example, assigning `"hello"` to a numeric `customer.age` fails compilation. This covers globals, visible locals, nested record fields, and list items, including computed indexes.

Checks include required fields, open/closed records, nullability, and handle identity. Unknown value shapes remain allowed. Defaults are not reapplied during writes. Action-output inference and runtime write validation remain separate work.

Stacked on #20882 for schema-backed locals. Reuses its expression-schema inference; most of that helper's diff is a file move. Five existing fixtures were corrected to match the values they actually write.

Validated with the compiler suite, compiler-to-engine integration suite, worker tests, Gym, seed-data, and dashboard-api tests; scoped compiler/worker/variables-api typechecks and compiler/worker lint pass. The integration test compiles and serializes a workflow, runs the real engine, and checks that nested updates preserve sibling fields and list items.

Linear: https://linear.app/sola-ai/issue/FE-1021/dsl-check-assignments-against-variable-schemas
